checks.rule: A high-confidence parcel height-difference candidate requires boundary provenance and elevation provenance as separate evidence chains.
General title-plan geometry cannot be silently upgraded to determined-boundary precision.
Elevation-source vertical RMSE must remain explicit and cannot be replaced by raster resolution.
Horizontal coordinate uncertainty and vertical elevation uncertainty are tracked separately.
Samples from different survey epochs require explicit temporal provenance before comparison.
DSM values contaminated by buildings or vegetation cannot be promoted as bare-earth parcel terrain values.
OS Terrain 5 fallback must remain distinguishable from higher-resolution Environment Agency LIDAR.
Uncovered official-source areas become NO_DATA rather than estimated height values.
A numeric result requires a reproducible CRS and vertical datum path, including OSTN15 or equivalent provenance where applicable.
A candidate remains guard-only until revision-14 runtime output proves an actual boundary-to-raster measurement path.
Remote integrity readback is required before any measured row is treated as publishable evidence.
No confidence score may imply measured parcel accuracy while official_measured_rows remains zero.
